name: @lpc-toolkit/cli
description: Node 22+ CLI for cataloging, validating, and rendering attributed LPC character sprites.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && pnpm --filter @lpc-toolkit/core build && pnpm --filter @lpc-toolkit/presets build && pnpm --filter @lpc-toolkit/web build:embedded && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-web-dist.mjs && node scripts/copy-token-decode-metadata.mjs && node scripts/vendor-workspace-deps.mjs && node scripts/copy-release-config.mjs
